europe_now.title: Estonia Closes Border Following Sabotage Attempt
europe_now.summary: Estonia has announced the closure of its border crossings with Russia after accusing Moscow of orchestrating an attempted arson attack on a local defense firm manufacturing drones.

sources.headline: Estonia to close Russian border crossings after 'sabotage' attempt at drone factory
Estonia accuses Russia of attempted arson attack on defense firm

europe_now.title: Mass Protests in Prague Over Public Media Funding
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of thousands of citizens gathered in Prague to demonstrate against government plans to alter the funding structure of public media organizations.

sources.headline: Hundreds of thousands of Czechs protest in Prague over public media funding plan

top_stories.title: Migrant Influx in Spain
top_stories.summary: Nearly 2,200 migrants arrived at Spain's Canary Islands over the course of a 48-hour period. Local officials have subsequently urged the central government to take immediate action.

sources.headline: Nearly 2,200 migrants reach Spain's Canary Islands in two days
Canaries urge government action after 2,200 migrants reach the islands in 48h

top_stories.title: Reproductive Rights Access in Poland
top_stories.summary: Polish activists are utilizing specialized lockers to dispense abortion pills in order to help women navigate restrictive national laws. These efforts have encountered active opposition from various groups.

sources.headline: Polish activists face opposition as they make abortion more accessible
